mostWorthwhile.text: Exposing asteroid-core fragments and adding them to proto-Earth made the distinction between inherited metal and Earth’s own later differentiation clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add water-bearing rock before the required intermediate, then finding neither the proto-Earth nor the rock had an available combination, was frustrating.

surprise.text: The collision exposed metal from a differentiated asteroid core, linking the fragments to the origin of some iron meteorites.

arbitrary.text: The need to add asteroid-core fragments before hydrated rock was not obvious from the physical explanation, even though the compatibility feedback eventually revealed the route.

continue.text: I would continue to see how Theia and the volatile-bearing young Earth lead to the Moon, especially if the story keeps distinguishing established processes from uncertain details.
